modes.cue_notes: Sit with both shins stacked parallel, one on top of the other like two logs. The ankle of the top leg rests on the knee of the bottom leg. Both shins should be parallel and roughly horizontal. Sit upright or fold forward. If the top knee is high off the floor, place a block or blanket under it. Ensure there is no sharp pain in the knee — the stretch should be felt in the outer hip. Hold each side.

source: Traditional yin yoga; see Paul Grilley, Bernie Clark, Sarah Powers
notes: Targets the deep lateral hip rotators (piriformis, obturators) and IT band. Gallbladder meridian runs the lateral hip and thigh. The knee should feel no pain — sensation should be in the outer hip only.
